https://codeload.github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/tar.gz/refs/tags/release-3.4.18
SHA256 c4b08b950bd29d83caae0ab8d884298d27046a9d30700fb42841c50992665c90
License: licenses/SDL3.txt, also included in the source archive.

Bundled to make Apple Silicon compilation independent of an installed SDL
or a network fetch. CMake verifies the SHA256 before extracting it.
